ios.desc:
Join thousands of users practicing languages through AI conversations.

Langs is a language practice app. Use your voice to speak with AI generated characters and practice your conversation skills in another language.

Or use our features to get suggested replies to your texts and translations to use outside of the app.

Features:*
• AI characters to chat with
• 25+ languages
• Create your own characters
• Character image generation
• Translate messages
• Message suggestions
• Custom voice selection

*These features are premium and require an App Store subscription.

Langs is perfect for practicing a language you’re learning.
For a challenge you can also try learning a completely new language through conversation.

Download for free today and explore our free trial.
